item.title: Using `animation-composition` in CSS to Avoid Redeclaring Other Values

item.title: Masonry (with Animation) in CSS
item.content:encoded: Masonry.js was famous for creating, uh, Masonry layouts. But it did something else, too: animate fluid grids. Here's a way to get that in native CSS as well as the layout.

item.title: Lumis: Syntax Highlighter powered by Tree-sitter
item.content:encoded: Lumis looks like a pretty sweet new syntax highlighter tool. Powered by Tree-sitter, of which I can vouch for its speed and power. I like how many runtimes it supports, almost encouraging server-side use, which is the best place for the job when you can pull it off.

item.title: Lessons Learned Rewriting a Sticky Detector
item.content:encoded: A dozen years go by, it turns out we can do things a lot differently and a lot better. Here a `scroll` event is entirely replaced by HTML and CSS features and much better performance.

item.title: In-N-Out Animation using sibling-index()
item.content:encoded: Temani mimics a View Transition by placing items using their index and translations. The placement calculation change when the index changes, which is an animation opportunity!
